result:
Baseline captured. The house language is: 20px padding, `text-lg font-semibold` header, `bg-neutral-100` rounded rows, grey secondary text, full-width black button pinned to the bottom.

Waiting on the three designers now. Current state of the list:

| # | Task | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Read spool contract + cart frame | done |
| 2 | Brief and launch three designers in parallel | done |
| 3 | Shot + review `cart--empty` | pending |
| 4 | Shot + review `cart--empty-b` | pending |
| 5 | Shot + review `cart--empty-c` | pending |
| 6 | Fix whatever the shots reveal | pending |

The three angles I assigned, so the takes actually diverge rather than being three shades of the same screen:

- **`cart--empty`** — restrained house continuity. Keeps `Din varukorg`, centred type, one line of support, one action. Craft is in what's left out.
- **`cart--empty-b`** — the empty state that does work. Leads with the guest's usual order as a one-tap re-order, then quick-add rows from the real menu. Utilitarian and dense.
- **`cart--empty-c`** — expressive brand moment. Warm espresso/cream palette, editorial serif, one CSS-only graphic idea, subtle motion. Breaks the white.

I'll shoot each one as it lands, read the PNG, and fix anything that looks wrong myself.

**`cart--empty` — done and verified.** Restrained take: `Din varukorg` stays put from the full cart, a hairline interrupted by a thin 48px ring, `Varukorgen är tom`, one grey support line naming a real price and the real address, `Till menyn` wired to `menu`. No shadows, no icon cliché, no kicker. Compiles, logs nothing, nothing clipped.

One thing worth knowing: the designer avoided Tailwind's `ring-*` utilities on purpose, because those compile to `box-shadow` and you'd have had a shadow in the frame without it being visible in the class names. The circle is a plain `border` with a white knockout box instead. There is zero `box-shadow` in that file.

Still waiting on B and C.
